entities.name: Samut
entities.description: A dissenter with twin khopeshes who rallies Amonkhet's survivors against the God-Pharaoh and whose planeswalker spark ignites as she is thanked by Hazoret.

entities.name: Djeru
entities.description: Samut's oldest friend, who now stands with her, devises the obelisk trap and kneels to Hazoret.

entities.name: Hazoret
entities.description: The last surviving god of Amonkhet, who burns the scorpion god, loses an arm and leads her people into the desert.

entities.name: Hapatra
entities.description: A vizier and master of poisons who declines to return to the city and instead leads the survivors to refuge in the sands.

entities.name: Haq
entities.description: A young vizier of Hazoret, no more than fourteen, who senses her presence and guides Samut's band to her.

entities.name: Masikah
entities.description: A tall, barrel-chested man of the Ahn crop who doubts that the God-Pharaoh is a lie.

entities.name: Neheb the Worthy
entities.description: A legendary minotaur champion who has become an Eternal wielding a spear of flame, killed by Samut.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The golden dragon who rains black fire on Naktamun and flies above it as the Gatewatch engages him.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who shields Djeru from Neheb and joins the other interlopers against Bolas.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who urges the group to approach Bolas carefully.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker whose dress is soaked in blood, who agrees Bolas already knows they are here.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker who heals injured warriors.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: One of the five interlopers who fight the Eternals alongside Gideon.

entities.name: The Scorpion God
entities.description: A corrupted god who pursues Hazoret, loses her arm to poison, and is killed by Hazoret after Samut and the survivors cripple it.

entities.name: The Scarab God
entities.description: A dark god who woke the Eternals and attacked the city.

entities.name: Bontu
entities.description: A god who betrayed Hazoret before falling.

entities.name: Rhonas
entities.description: The dead God of Strength whose body lies in the street and whose staff a khenra reforges and wields.

entities.name: The Eternals
entities.description: Undead champions coated in lazotep who hunt the city's survivors.

entities.name: The Gatewatch
entities.description: The five interloping planeswalkers who set out to slay Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Khenra Warrior
entities.description: An unnamed khenra who lifts Rhonas's staff and strikes the scorpion god for Rhonas.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: The ruined city of Amonkhet.

entities.name: Gate to the Afterlife
entities.description: The gate from the direction of which a sandstorm sweeps in.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: The desert plane under Bolas's destruction.

entities.name: Hour of Devastation
entities.description: The unnamed hour when Bolas completes his plan, leaving the city in ruins.

entities.name: Curse of Wandering
entities.description: The curse raising corpses to roam the streets.

events.summary: Samut leads a band of survivors toward the desert at Hazoret's command, guarded by Djeru.
events.quote: Hazoret's command burned at the back of Samut's thoughts as they moved.

events.summary: Nicol Bolas emerges from a void in the sky and rains black fire on the city and its cheering mortals.
events.quote: That was when the dragon raised his hands, and black fire fell from the skies.

events.summary: Samut tells the survivors that the God-Pharaoh is a lie and a trespasser, and Masikah doubts her.
events.quote: He is a trespasser, an interloper from another world.

events.summary: The survivors all feel the pain of a fourth god dying, and Samut tells them four gods are now dead.
events.quote: Four of our gods are now dead.

events.summary: Djeru publicly declares he stands with Samut against the God-Pharaoh.
events.quote: I have seen more than I needed to realize she speaks truth.

events.summary: Samut resolves to go back into the city to protect Hazoret, and Djeru and other warriors join her while Hapatra stays to guide the survivors into the sands.
events.quote: I am Rhonas's broken fang, and I know where to strike to stop the undead and the monstrosities in their tracks.

events.summary: Samut and Djeru fight the Eternal Neheb the Worthy and are beaten back.
events.quote: Neheb swung his spear forward, sending a wave of flame at Samut.

events.summary: Gideon blocks Neheb's spear and the Gatewatch destroy the Eternals; Samut stabs Neheb and kills him.
events.quote: She sprinted toward the Eternal minotaur and stabbed him in the back with both khopeshes

events.summary: The Gatewatch decide to bring the fight to Bolas, and Samut charges them to slay Nicol Bolas.
events.quote: Slay the dragon trespasser. Slay Nicol Bolas.

events.summary: Djeru persuades Samut to stand down and find the last god while the Gatewatch fight Bolas.
events.quote: Find the last god of Amonkhet, protect her, and protect the people of our city.

events.summary: Samut and Djeru, guided by the young vizier Haq, find Rhonas's body and Samut rallies the survivors.
events.quote: We will embody the strength Rhonas taught us

events.summary: A sandstorm sweeps in as an injured Hazoret emerges pursued by the scorpion god.
events.quote: A scorpion's tail pierced through the haze

events.summary: Hazoret traps the scorpion god in a pillar of flame, but it keeps coming and poisons her arm, which she cauterizes and severs.
events.quote: Hazoret crouched, panting hard, blood seeping from the wound that had saved her life.

events.summary: Samut leaps onto the scorpion god and cuts through its softened carapace while the survivors fight it.
events.quote: She smashed into the scorpion god's side, and her blades pierced its carapace

events.summary: A khenra warrior wields Rhonas's reforged staff to knock the scorpion god back toward Djeru's trap.
events.quote: A lone khenra stood, hoisting Rhonas's staff into the air

events.summary: Djeru trips the scorpion god and Samut redirects its fall so an obelisk pierces its chest.
events.quote: an earth-shattering crunch echoed across the battlefield as the obelisk pierced the scorpion god's chest.

events.summary: Hazoret finishes the scorpion god with her spear, freeing him as her brother from his dark form.
events.quote: the god reduced to cinders and ash.

events.summary: Hazoret thanks Samut, and Samut's planeswalker spark ignites; she is carried to another plane and returns to Amonkhet.
events.quote: she was falling, falling through space, through flashing waves of aether

events.summary: Samut realizes she is a walker between worlds and returns to Amonkhet, then collapses and is caught by Hazoret.
events.quote: I am a walker between worlds.

events.summary: Hazoret tells the survivors to endure and leads them into the desert as Bolas flies above, and Djeru and the survivors kneel to her.
events.quote: we must simply endure, persist, survive

relations.quote: this time piercing the base of its neck.

relations.note: burned him from the inside with her spear
relations.quote: black smoke billowed forth from the scorpion god as it burned from the inside

relations.note: oldest friends, called sister and brother
she calls him the great trespasser and urges the Gatewatch to slay him
relations.quote: We must defy the great trespasser.
As a vizier of Hazoret, though, his heart beat as one with his god
That is the second time today that you have saved me.
